module: GE extension (core_audioForest): runtime coordinator of forest audio emitters. From the level's Forest trees/objects, it builds a thinned cloud of audio nodes (audioForestCommon), then every frame computes the weighted average position of the nodes around the listener (radius 150 m) and moves a single SFX emitter (the 'main emitter') to that point while setting its FMOD parameters (RTPC). An independent 'roomtone' emitter can also play an ambience. Per-level settings are read from levels/<level>/dynamicAudioEmitters/forestData.audioSFX.json (created by the editor). The RTPCs: volume = intensity, pitch = node density, color = vegetation size, texture = unused; the global parameter g_ForestHeight = listener height relative to the forest centroid (or the terrain).
usage:
-- Driven by the editor or by the level file. Manual control:
core_audioForest.setMainEvent('event:>Ambiance>Forest>Mon_event')
core_audioForest.setEnabled(true)
notes: Level file format: JSON lines (one 'meta' line, then one 'shape' line per forest model with include, classSel, classOvr).
When the level loads (onClientCustomObjectSpawning) and after a Lua reload (onDeserialized), the state is rebuilt from the file; onSerialize returns nothing useful ({}).
The node cloud computation is spread over several frames (runtimeLoadStepCount = 10000 objects per frame) via startRuntimePrepass/stepRuntimePrepass.
Internal constants: listening radius 150 m, volume gain 30, g_ForestHeight write threshold 0.05 m, emitter raised by 0.05 m.

Risk: onUpdate calls em:setPosition / em:setVolumePitchCT without checking that the main emitter exists; if enabled is true while mainEventName is empty (so there is no emitter), this raises a nil error (inferred from code).
Node coordinates are in world meters; a node's depth (nodeDepth) is the object height multiplied by nodeHeightBlend (0.5).

setEnabled.desc: Enables or disables the system. On enable, creates the main emitter if there is an event and nodes; on disable, removes it.

setNodeCloud.desc: Installs a node cloud produced by audioForestCommon.buildNodeCloudFromForest (used by the editor or the runtime). Fetches the terrain (core_terrain.getTerrain) and the global audio parameters; returns false and clears the state if the cloud is invalid or there is no terrain.

cloud.desc: Cloud: nodeCount, nodeX, nodeY, nodeZ, nodeDepth, nodeAvgNormVol, nodeSourceCount, pitchDensityInv, kdNodes

setMainEvent.desc: Sets the FMOD event of the main emitter (without touching the roomtone). Empty string: removes the emitter. Otherwise updates the existing emitter or creates it if the system is enabled and has nodes.

setRoomtoneEnabled.desc: Enables or disables the independent 'roomtone' emitter (creates it if there is a roomtone event).

setRoomtoneEvent.desc: Sets the roomtone event. No visible effect until the roomtone is enabled; empty string: removes the emitter.

setRoomtoneZ.desc: Sets the altitude of the roomtone emitter (positioned at x=0, y=0).

setPitchDensityInv.desc: Overrides the automatic pitch normalization (inverse of the number of reference sources). nil or value <= 0: reverts to automatic.

getEmitterNodeIds.desc: For the editor: returns the table {[1] = id of the nearest representative node} and size 1.

returns.desc: Array of node ids (0 if none)

getMainEmitterDebugState.desc: For editor visualization: current state of the main emitter.

returns.desc: true if the emitter is active (nodes are within the radius)

clearMainAudio.desc: Removes only the main audio path (emitter and event name).

clear.desc: Resets the whole runtime state (emitters, nodes, tool state, settings).

setPersistedToolState.desc: Stores the editing tool state for saving the level.

st.desc: State: version, mainEvent, roomtoneEnabled, roomtoneEvent, roomtoneZ, includeByShape, classSelByShape, classOverrideByShape, nodeVisDrawRadius, nodeVisSphereRadius, showNodes, selectedRow

getPersistedToolState.desc: Returns the currently loaded tool state.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame by the extension system: advances the loading prepass, then moves the main emitter and sets its RTPCs according to the nodes near the listener (SFXSystem.getPositionXYZ).

onClientCustomObjectSpawning.desc: Hook called when the level objects are created: loads the level configuration and starts the prepass.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of a level: resets the whole state.

onEditorBeforeSaveLevel.desc: Hook called by the editor before the level is saved: writes the stored tool state to levels/<level>/dynamicAudioEmitters/forestData.audioSFX.json.

onSerialize.desc: Serialization hook before Lua reload: returns an empty table.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook after Lua reload: re-reads the level configuration and rebuilds the state.
